map.提示：3个月以下婴儿发热≥38°C(肛温)需立即就医。退热药首选对乙酰氨基酚(≥: Note: infants <3 months with fever ≥38°C (rectal) need immediate care. Antipyretic first choice: acetaminophen (≥2 mo) or ibuprofen (≥6 mo). Do not alternate/combine two antipyretics. Physical cooling: tepid sponge bath; no alcohol rub. Fever is an immune response; do not chase a fully normal temperature - focus on comfort. This tool is for care reference only.
map.腋温 38.5°C 即发热(肛温校正 +0.5=39.0)；精神好可观察补水。: Axillary 38.5°C is fever (rectal correction +0.5 = 39.0); if alert, observe and hydrate.
map.月龄小、热>3–5 天、精神差、惊厥→及时就医，不盲目退热。: Young infant, fever >3-5 days, poor spirits, seizures -> seek care promptly, do not blindly antipyrese.
map.肛/耳比腋高约 0.5°C、口高 0.3°C，统一换算再判发热。: Rectal/ear ~0.5°C and oral ~0.3°C higher than axillary; convert uniformly before judging fever.
map.≥38.5°C 或明显不适用退热药，重点在饮水与观察精神。: ≥38.5°C or clearly unwell; antipyretic; focus on fluids and watching alertness.
